EC-001.note: Native New Image is available from the tray and editor File menu/Ctrl+N, with validated dimensions, transparent or ARGB background, four colour profiles and explicit file/clipboard initial pixels. Qt Core composes native-size top-left pixels with declared crop/padding; codecs prepare an immutable profiled PNG/document and private sRGB display copy. Cancellable workers complete before dirty Save/Discard/Cancel replacement, defaulting to Cancel. New sessions have no persistence checkpoint until successful saving, including after Undo to their initial source. Independent pixel/profile/alpha/PNG/xann tests and actual native controls verify invalid inputs, cancelled pickers/work, failed raster/sidecar saves, cancelled untitled Save, immutable prior history/selection/viewport/files, new session action bindings and persistence. Published New Image vectors and full capability qualification remain pending. Captured-source recovery uses a cancellable native worker to prepare owned pixel-normalized source/PNG/document and a private sRGB view, preserving alpha/profile and inferring no original save path. Native source/editor tests cover borrowed-buffer lifetime, pixel-ratio normalization, bounds, staged cancellation, redacted exceptions, unsaved history/close semantics and explicit Save As without touching the original capture.

Native tests verify picker/loading cancellation, typed decode/sidecar failures, all replacement choices, unchanged prior history/selection/viewport/files, fresh clean adoption, and reload after explicit Save overwrites the candidate, including untitled Save. Native editor/tray recent selection now uses the same validated Open flow. The Qt Core model defaults off, validates a 1..100 maximum (default 10), deduplicates using injected POSIX/Windows rules, orders newest first, removes/clears missing entries, and clears on opt-out. Native Manage controls apply a draft atomically or cancel it, guard against an incoming Open overwriting a stale list, and leave document/history/viewport/files untouched. Recent preferences now survive restart through isolated private atomic storage, with unknown-field retention and privacy-pruned previous settings. Native Apply/Cancel, stale revisions, failed writes and complete/incomplete image-save tests verify publication and document independence. Full settings metadata, retention/recovery policy and human privacy/security/compatibility qualification remain Required. Complete working/export-profile composition remains pending. POSIX parent-directory segments and chosen symlink paths remain intact through CLI/editor absolute-path preparation and menu action data; real symlink/source tests prove a recent entry reopens the same pixels.

EC-005.note: EditorViewport holds zoom and pan outside document history. Native actions, Control+wheel, pinch, scrollbars, middle drag, Space+drag, and keyboard pan share that state. EC-006.note: Finite zoom is bounded to 1/64..64. Zoom keeps the logical point under the pointer unless image visibility bounds require clamping; native scrollbars and pan keep at least a 32px strip accessible. The status bar exposes zoom. Native tests cover wheel/pinch anchoring, finite bounds, zoom-independent hit targets and rotated previews.

Stroke-grown rotated intersection removes wholly outside rectangles, translates retained objects, and clips partial objects at export. CANVAS-POLICY.md documents the policy; native tests exercise pointer cancellation, dialog crop, undo/redo and sidecar reopening. Native capture Crop now shares normalized reverse/clipped numeric/pointer bounds, an owned worker preview and one guarded Core history commit. Private in-memory source regions compose through crops/history, while the capture worker independently reproduces original-source pixels before accepting changed source/dimensions. Actual objects/assets/alpha, no-op/Cancel, source/viewport Undo/Redo, typed unknown refusal, PNG/.xann reopen and retry are indexed in CAPTURE-CROP.md. Main-editor numeric and pointer Crop now reuse the owned preview with frozen state/exact selection/generation, one canvas commit, prepared source/private display and nonblocking Cancel/child/owner teardown. Native keyboard/pointer, inverse-rotation compatibility, alpha/profile/fields/assets, exact history/checkpoint, stale/unknown refusal and actual PNG/.xann reopen are indexed in EDITOR-CROP.md.

EC-008.note: Native Auto Crop exposes border reference, alpha threshold, inclusive RGBA channel tolerance and whether visible annotations contribute to bounds. The Qt Core engine renders without flattening, scans deterministically, and reuses the crop intersection policy. Empty/full bounds are no-ops with no history. Core and native-window tests cover exact bounds/pixels, alpha and colour thresholds, editable annotations, row-level cancellation, save/reopen and one-step undo.

EC-009.note: Native pixel resize has aspect locking, nearest and alpha-aware bilinear interpolation, dimension limits, and retained rectangle scaling. General non-uniform transforms of rotated or stroked annotations require affine object support; those cases currently fail atomically rather than distort or discard objects. Integer aspect rounding can also produce unequal scales. CanvasOperationsTest covers sampling, alpha and limits.

EC-010.note: Native Resize Canvas provides nine anchors, explicit alpha/colour fill, exact retained-pixel copies and annotation translation/removal. CANVAS-POLICY.md defines odd-size alignment and the intersection policy. Unit and native window tests cover expansion, shrink, anchors, colour/alpha, save and undo.

EC-011.note: Native quarter turns, custom rotation and flips transform source pixels, dimensions, rectangle centres/orientations and pixel-centre coordinates atomically. Custom rotation has explicit expansion/cropping, background and sampling policies; exact expanded quarter turns are lossless. Tests cover independent pixel permutations, analytical 45-degree output, alpha-aware border interpolation, limits, editable persistence and undo. Directional/inserted assets await their tool implementations.

EC-012.note: Native Rotate Image exposes angle, nearest/bilinear interpolation, expand/crop and uncovered-pixel ARGB controls. A cancellable worker prepares the complete source/document and authoritative rendered preview without entering session history. Changes invalidate obsolete previews; accepting commits exactly the prepared result with a state guard, once. Native tests exercise the cancelled 17-degree annotated/dirty scenario, rejection of an obsolete preview, controls, live-worker cancellation, save/reopen and one-step history; core tests verify independent sampling and atomic failures.

EC-014.note: Native Flatten composites the current source and supported visible annotations into an encoded immutable source, clearing only IDs with positive rendered coverage. Hidden, transparent, zero-opacity, off-canvas and hidden unsupported objects remain; visible unsupported types fail atomically. Assets remain reachable throughout history. Core and native file/window tests verify independent source-over pixels, profile preservation, represented-object filtering, selection/source undo, no-op repetition and live-worker cancellation. Separate background layers await EC-013; full flatten qualification remains pending.

EC-015.note: Distinct native Clear Annotations and Clear Image and Annotations commands share atomic history. Annotation clear retains source PNG bytes exactly. Pixel clear uses an accessible native confirmation defaulting to Cancel, offers Save before Clear/Clear without Saving for dirty sessions, retains dimensions/profile and complete Undo recovery, and changes files only after explicit save. Core and native window tests cover cancellation, save/discard/clear choices, checkpoint and selection restoration, unsupported-object recovery and transparent PNG output. New Image replacement now prepares the complete new source before native Save/Discard/Cancel confirmation, defaulting to Cancel; cancellation and incomplete saves keep the current dirty session and history. Save and Discard intentionally adopt a fresh unsaved session only after success/confirmation. Native window tests cover all choices, untitled destination cancellation, failed raster and sidecar persistence, and preserved old files except explicit Save. Open-in-place now validates the candidate before the same confirmation; native tests verify Save/Discard/Cancel, unchanged state on invalid/cancelled input, clean adoption and reload of an explicitly saved overlapping candidate.

Private display copies use sRGB without modifying source pixels/profiles. Native slider accessibility, keyboard/mouse control, file-picker cancellation, failed replacement, live-worker cancellation/close and complete session/history/selection/viewport/file invariance have native tests.
